1.1.3.1-r1.burton_quote: calls those Melancholy, whom abundance of that same depraved humour of black Choler hath so misaffected, that they become mad thence, and dote in most things, or in all, belonging to election, will, or other manifest operations of the understanding

1.1.3.1-r2.burton_quote: a bad and peevish disease, which makes men degenerate into beasts

1.1.3.1-r3.burton_quote: a perpetual anguish of the soul, fastened on one thing, without an ague

1.1.3.1-r4.burton_quote: rather showing what it is not, than what it is
